title: Logarithmic Space for the Drop Languages
statement: For each choice of mode $m\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the language defined by accepting an encoded pair $(z,q)$ when either $q$ is less than the length of the transformed word obtained by dropping the nested encoding from $z$ (if $m=\mathrm{true}$), or its $q$-th bit is $1$ (if $m=\mathrm{false}$), is decidable in logarithmic space.
